reasoning: 23.7.1（MW7.1）規定 "All Presets" 按鈕只在支援 preset 的來源下可用。這是條件式可用性，驗證必須成對：支援 preset 的來源（FM）下按鈕存在，不支援的來源下不存在——只驗其一無法證明 only available for。不支援 preset 的來源以 USB 為例：Table BT3.1（14.3.1）與 ch16 的 PRE1 顯示 preset bank 涵蓋 AM/FM/SXM/DAB，USB 不在其中，故為 spec 可支撐的對照組而非自行挑選。spec 未規定不支援時按鈕是隱藏或變灰，故 ER 以「未顯示為可用」表述並涵蓋兩種可能，依 §8.4 不臆測呈現方式。註（A-028）：本條在 2023 PDF 上標為 MW7.1，縮排卻在 MW8 之下；SYS1 outline 歸為 23.7.1，生成依 outline。容器錨定：ch23 的第三個容器是由 widget 的 "All Presets" 按鈕開啟的彈窗。它與 ch18 APP1 的同名彈窗是否為同一個尚未裁決（A-030），故 ER 一律以入口路徑指稱（the popup opened from the "All Presets" button in the Media Widget），在命名歧義未決前這比任何名稱都穩。依 §8.4.2，本章只驗 ch23 條文明載的內容，不從 ch18 進口 APP 行為——該彈窗若有 Edit Presets 按鈕那是 ch18 的事，若沒有更不關 ch23 的事。優先級：屬按鈕的條件式可用性，訂 P2。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 兩筆分別為支援 preset 的來源與不支援的來源，構成 only available for 的成對驗證

tcs.test_item:
The system shall display the 'All Presets' button only for sources that allow presets.

(Source that allows presets (FM))
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. FM is the active source on the HU
2. At least one FM station is stored as a preset
3. The Media Widget is displayed on the Home Screen
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Home" on Main Menu Bar to open the Home Screen
2. Read the controls displayed in the Media Widget
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Home Screen is displayed and the Media Widget is displayed on it
2. An "All Presets" button is displayed in the Media Widget in an enabled state

tcs.test_item:
The system shall display the 'All Presets' button only for sources that allow presets.

(Source that does not allow presets (USB))
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A USB drive containing at least one file with a valid audio format is connected to the HU
2. USB is the active source on the HU
3. The Media Widget is displayed on the Home Screen
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Home" on Main Menu Bar to open the Home Screen
2. Read the controls displayed in the Media Widget
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Home Screen is displayed and the Media Widget is displayed on it
2. No "All Presets" button is displayed in an enabled state in the Media Widget
